annotations.title: Change a tool's words or store listing

description: The tool's name, its line, its description, or its Chrome Web Store listing (the store link or the 32-letter id), on Test. Only what is sent changes. The store listing makes the store's copy one the tool key opens for: set it once the item exists.

tool.description: The tool id, as toolaby_list_tools gives it (like "acme--word-counter"); the short one ("word-counter") works when it names one tool.

name: toolaby_update_tool
